caption: The model (amber) does all the reasoning; long-term memory (green) is the only thing kept between questions. Each box names the Part that builds it.
Left: the question and each memory as arrows; the smaller the angle to the question, the closer the meaning. Right: the same memories ranked by distance (schematic).
Scanners produce facts; only new or changed facts are embedded (amber, inside the database) and then stored (green).
